問題 6 According to documents provided by Hop On Management Company Limited (“Hop On”) to the Committee, your client appears to have handled or solicited a total of 131 proxies in relation to the EGM which took place on 11 December 2021 (including proxies where she was not personally appointed a proxy). We enclose a copy of the table which is believed to be prepared by ISS entitled “授權黃碧嫻的單位.xlsx”. Kindly confirm whether that was the case, and explain the nature of your client’s involvement in relation to the proxies listed in the table. Please also confirm whether your client handled or solicited proxies for other AGMs or EGMs albeit not personally appointed as proxy and if so the number of those proxies.

回答 6 關於 131 張授權票

26. 正如上文第 8 段（回答 1.2）所述，本人確認義工團隊當時的確協助居民要求本人協助提交的合共 131 張授權票，但當中絕大部分是授權予其他法團委員及社區好友，亦包括授權予本人的僅約 20 多張。本人在協助收集未指名本人的授權票時，純粹是協助其支持的團隊（即反對罷免的現居法團）進行行政統籌及代收代交。
